source.description: Where versions/*.zip come from; omit for the local directory

prefix.description: Folder in the bucket holding the zips, e.g. prod/

endpoint.description: https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com for R2, http://host:9000 for MinIO; omit for AWS

accessKeyId.description: Optional with secretAccessKey; leave both out to use the AWS credential chain (env, IAM role, IRSA, SSO)

poll.description: How often the bucket is listed, at least 5s

dateFormat.description: Date layout for backend keys, comparisons and posted facts: YYYY, MM or M, dd or d, separated by . - or /

default.description: Bundle for visitors without a cookie and when nothing matches

backend.description: Oldest backend version each bundle supports: {"<backend>": "<bundle>"}

rules.description: Checked top to bottom before the backend table; the first match wins

note.description: Free text for operators, ignored by the gateway

when.description: Every entry must match (AND); a missing fact never matches

until.description: Expiry: YYYY-MM-DD (active through the end of that UTC day) or an RFC 3339 time

matcher.description: Exact value; "*" = fact present; "N%" = sticky percentage of values; "<2.0.0" / ">=07.31.2026" = comparison, several parts separated by spaces must all hold
